bio.text: Steve Hollowell is a Republican member of the Arkansas House of Representatives for District 37, which covers parts of Cross, Poinsett and St. Francis counties.
The legislature's member page lists Hollowell's first House term as 2017 and service as a Forrest City alderman from 2003 to 2016.

sources.title: Representative Steve Hollowell (R) - Arkansas State Legislature
